zones.name: Luminarie Lane
zones.blurb: The lane of light arches from the Gold Gate, with a market of hand-made gifts.

zones.name: Santa Land
zones.blurb: The family zone: Santa's Grotto, the Elves' Workshop, gentle rides and the Jingle Bell Bistro.

zones.name: Arctic Circle
zones.blurb: Everything made of ice: the Magical Ice Kingdom, Bar Ice, the ice slide and sculpting workshops.

zones.name: Thrillville
zones.blurb: The big rides: the Giant Wheel, Munich Looping, the Hangover drop tower and the Street Food Village.

zones.name: Bavarian Village
zones.blurb: Chalet bars, beer halls, bratwurst and two coasters.

zones.name: Market Square
zones.blurb: The Christmas Market's wooden chalets, The Sleigh-By street food and a bandstand with live music.

zones.name: Show Town
zones.blurb: The circus big top, the Circus Bar and traditional fairground rides.

zones.name: Skater's Corner
zones.blurb: The ice rink round the Victorian bandstand, Bar Narnia and the Fire Pit stage.

items.name: The Giant Wheel
items.note: 70m observation wheel. 10-minute flights, sessions 10:00 to 21:30.
items.price: Adult £8.80 off-peak, £9.90 standard, £12.10 peak (advance). Child £6.60 to £9.90. Family £26.40 to £39.60. Private pod for up to six £46.20 to £61.60.

items.name: Munich Looping
items.note: Five-loop rollercoaster.
items.price: £12.00 advance, £12.50 on the day
items.height: 1.3m to 1.95m; under 1.4m with an adult. Age 8+.

items.name: Aeronaut Starflyer
items.note: 80m swing ride.
items.price: £8.80 advance, £9.00 on the day

items.name: The Hangover
items.note: 85m drop tower.

items.name: The XXL
items.note: Pendulum ride, swings to 47m.

items.name: Blizzard
items.note: Spins riders 360 degrees, 65m above the park.
items.price: £9.90 advance, £10.00 on the day

items.name: Airborne
items.note: Flips and rolls 65m up.
items.price: £8.80 advance, £9.00 on the day

items.name: Euro Coaster
items.note: Suspended coaster on a 370m track.
items.price: Adult £7.50; child £5.50 advance, £6.00 on the day

items.name: Haunted Mansion
items.note: Walk-through scare attraction.
items.price: Adult £7.50; child £5.50 advance, £6.00 on the day

items.name: Après-Ski Party Funhouse
items.note: Ski-themed walk-through funhouse over several floors: moving steps, wobbly floors and a double slide.
items.price: £5.50 advance, £6.00 on the day

items.name: Ice Mountain
items.note: Indoor spinning rollercoaster through mountain caverns, with penguins and northern lights.
items.price: Adult £7.70 advance, £8.50 on the day. Child £5.50 advance, £6.50 on the day.
items.fastTrack: Adult £11.00 advance, £11.50 on the day. Child £8.80 advance, £9.50 on the day.

items.name: Snow Jet
items.note: Sleigh ride round a winter snowscape that speeds up partway through.
items.price: Adult £6.50. Child £5.50 advance, £6.00 on the day.

items.name: The Time Machine
items.note: Steampunk-themed ride that twists and spins.
items.price: Adult £7.50. Child £5.50 advance, £6.00 on the day.

items.name: Traditional Wave Swinger
items.note: Vintage chair-swing ride, hand-painted.
items.price: Adult £5.50. Child £4.50.

items.name: Wilde Maus XXL Coaster
items.note: Wild-mouse coaster: small cars taken fast round tight hairpin turns.
items.price: Adult £9.90 advance, £10.50 on the day. Child £7.70 advance, £8.00 on the day.

items.name: Spinning Racer
items.note: Family coaster whose cars spin as they run.
items.price: Adult £8.00 advance, £8.50 on the day. Child £6.00 advance, £6.50 on the day.

items.name: The Ice Rink by Priority from O2
items.note: Open-air rink built round the Victorian bandstand. 45-minute sessions from 10:00 to 21:00; arrive 20 minutes before yours.
items.price: Adult £12.65 off-peak to £19.25 peak in advance (£14.65 to £21.25 on the day). Child £9.35 to £13.75. Family £37.40 to £55.00. Ice guide £39.50.

items.name: Magical Ice Kingdom presents Neverland
items.note: Walk-through of hand-carved ice and snow sculptures telling the Peter Pan story, made from 500 tonnes of ice and snow. About 20 minutes; 10:00 to 21:00.
items.price: Adult £10.20 off-peak to £14.60 peak in advance (£11.20 to £15.60 on the day). Child £8.00 to £12.40. Family £32.00 to £49.60.

items.name: Bar Ice
items.note: Bar carved from ice, kept at -10°C, with a DJ. 20-minute sessions, 11:00 to 21:20; a cocktail is in the ticket.
items.price: £17.05 off-peak to £19.80 peak in advance (£18.05 to £20.80 on the day), adult or child.

items.name: Real Ice Slide powered by Joybuy
items.note: Ride down the ice on a tube; two goes per ticket. 10:00 to 21:00. Not wheelchair accessible.
items.price: £5.50 advance, £6.50 on the day

items.name: Ice Sculpting Workshops
items.note: Carve an ice sculpture in pairs. Sessions on the hour, 12:30 to 19:30; includes two Magical Ice Kingdom tickets.
items.price: £67.65 for two in advance (£78.65 peak); £69.65 and £80.65 on the day.

items.name: Santa's Grotto
items.note: Meet Santa. 10:00 to 18:00, first come first served; the queue can close at 17:00.
items.price: Free

items.name: The Elves' Workshop
items.note: Puzzles and giant cogs to turn. All day, first come first served.
items.price: Free

items.name: Gandeys K-Pop Dragon Circus
items.note: Circus show that mixes K-pop with circus acts. New for 2026. Shows at 14:00, 16:00 and 18:00, plus 12:00 and 20:00 on some days.
items.price: Adult £13.75 off-peak to £19.80 peak in advance; ringside £15.95 to £22.00. Child £10.45 to £16.50. Family £41.80 to £66.00.

items.name: Christmas by Candlelight
items.note: Christmas songs sung live by West End performers, by candlelight. 5, 6, 11, 13, 20 and 23 December.
items.price: From £35.00

items.price: Free

items.name: Gold Gate
items.note: Closest stations: Marble Arch and Paddington. Nearest zones: Arctic Circle and Luminarie Lane.

items.name: Red Gate
items.note: Closest stations: Bond Street and Marble Arch. Nearest zones: Santa Land and Thrillville.

items.name: Green Gate
items.note: Closest stations: Knightsbridge and High Street Kensington. Nearest zones: Bavarian Village and Market Square.

items.name: Blue Gate
items.note: Closest stations: Hyde Park Corner, Green Park and Victoria. Nearest zones: Skater's Corner and Show Town.

items.name: Paddington station
items.note: Elizabeth, Bakerloo, Circle, District and Hammersmith & City lines. About a 12-minute walk; nearest gate: Gold Gate.

items.name: Bond Street, Marble Arch and Oxford Circus stations
items.note: Bond Street (Central, Jubilee and Elizabeth lines, with lifts) is about a 14-minute walk. Marble Arch is closer but busy and can close. Nearest gate: Red Gate.

items.name: High Street Kensington and Knightsbridge stations
items.note: Nearest gate: Green Gate. At Knightsbridge, use the Hans Crescent exit for Harrods.

items.name: Victoria, Hyde Park Corner and Green Park stations
items.note: Green Park (Piccadilly and Jubilee lines, with lifts) is about a 17-minute walk; Victoria about 19 minutes. Hyde Park Corner is closest but busy and can close. Nearest gate: Blue Gate.
